title: Browser を ungoogled-chromium に差し替え（ライセンス解消 + サインイン促進除去）

planning_decisions.decision: Single Story (Sfd04db-1) kept as-is, treated as a non-GUI image/infra Story (test type: cli/infra against real incus). It does not add a new HTTP route / CLI flag / GUI screen — it swaps the bundled browser binary inside the palmux-ws image and tweaks an existing chromium launch. So gui-spec produces no GUI scenario; verification is a real-machine incus smoke (test-discipline Rule 7 production mode).
planning_decisions.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority_rule 6 (reuse > new), VISION tech_constraints (single-binary, image distributed as release asset). The user-observable surface added (the two chromium flags) is exercised by the real-incus browser launch smoke, satisfying test-discipline Rule 6.

implementation_decisions.decision: ungoogled-chromium source = XtraDeb PPA (ppa:xtradeb/apps), Launchpad apt repo 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/xtradeb/apps/ubuntu noble main'. Pinned version 149.0.7827.114-1.1xtradeb1.2404.1 (noble/amd64). GPG signing key fingerprint 5301FA4FD93244FBC6F6149982BB6851C64F6880 fetched from keyserver.ubuntu.com and verified-by-fingerprint before trust.
implementation_decisions.rationale: It is the ONLY actively-maintained, noble-targeting, redistributable ungoogled-chromium .deb source. The official ungoogled-chromium-binaries site only has a 2022 v100 'unportable/unreproducible' Debian build; the openSUSE OBS personal repo home:ungoogled_chromium is empty and has no noble target. XtraDeb's InRelease is GPG-signed, giving a verifiable supply chain. AC-Sfd04db-1-1.

implementation_decisions.decision: Belt-and-suspenders supply-chain check: pin UGCHROMIUM_VERSION AND UGCHROMIUM_DEB_SHA256=2f8bf341245d134b717f84f1788eec44951a84031620a2c4fb619b7c0fff0997 (captured from the signed Packages.xz index). build.sh apt-get download's the pinned .deb (apt verifies the signed Release->Packages->.deb SHA256 chain) THEN re-verifies the .deb sha256sum against the hardcoded pin before installing.
implementation_decisions.rationale: AC asks to 'pin a specific version + verify sha256'. Apt's signed chain alone could let a silently rotated pool entry through if the index were re-signed; the second hardcoded SHA256 check makes the build fail-closed on any drift. AC-Sfd04db-1-1.

implementation_decisions.decision: ungoogled-chromium Depends on ungoogled-chromium-common (= same version); both installed at the pin. Runtime libs (libnss3, libgtk-3-0t64, libgbm1, libasound2t64, ...) resolved by apt-get install from the ubuntu noble base archive. apt also pulls ungoogled-chromium-sandbox, l10n, driver as recommends-free deps.
implementation_decisions.rationale: Keeps the install fully apt-managed so deps resolve on the ubuntu/24.04 image base (AC-Sfd04db-1-1 'runtime deps install on the base').

implementation_decisions.decision: The XtraDeb package installs the launcher as /usr/bin/ungoogled-chromium (NOT chromium). build.sh probes [ungoogled-chromium, chromium, chromium-browser] in order, symlinks the first found to /usr/local/bin/chromium, and fails loudly if none exist + runs `chromium --version` as a sanity check. chromiumBin='chromium' in browser.go is unchanged.
implementation_decisions.rationale: First build attempt failed at the verify loop ('chromium not found after install') because the old `command -v chromium || echo /usr/bin/chromium` fallback created a dangling symlink. Fixed by probing the real launcher name. Keeps chromiumBin resolution working. AC-Sfd04db-1-3.

implementation_decisions.decision: Added --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check to launchChromium (internal/tab/browser/browser.go). Did NOT remove --no-sandbox / --remote-debugging-port=9222 / --remote-allow-origins=* / --user-data-dir / --window-size / --window-position. Launch order (Xvfb->dbus->fcitx5->chromium->x11vnc->CDP relay) and IME env (GTK_IM_MODULE=fcitx etc.) untouched.
implementation_decisions.rationale: AC-Sfd04db-1-2 sign-in suppression; preserve CDP + IME + noVNC parity (AC-Sfd04db-1-3).

implementation_decisions.decision: Baked Chromium managed policy at /etc/chromium/policies/managed/palmux.json = {BrowserSignin:0, SyncDisabled:true, PromotionalTabsEnabled:false}. Used the Debian/Chromium path /etc/chromium/policies/managed/, NOT google-chrome's /etc/opt/chrome/policies/managed/.
implementation_decisions.rationale: VERIFIED ON REAL INCUS via strace: the XtraDeb ungoogled-chromium binary opens exactly /etc/chromium/policies/managed/palmux.json at startup (strace -e openat showed `/etc/chromium/policies/managed` + the palmux.json file; the alternative dirs /etc/ungoogled-chromium/policies/managed and /etc/chromium-browser/policies/managed were NOT opened). chrome://policy then reports BrowserSignin=0 (Mandatory OK), SyncDisabled=true (Mandatory OK), PromotionalTabsEnabled=false (Mandatory). So the build.sh path is correct. AC-Sfd04db-1-2.
implementation_decisions.verification: real-incus: strace openat trace + chrome://policy policy-table read via CDP/playwright-core

license_note.summary: ungoogled-chromium = BSD-3-Clause (Chromium base + project modifications); redistributable. Google web-service integration + telemetry removed => no Google ToS, no sign-in promo. Bundling in the public GitHub-Release palmux-ws image is license-clean. Full note: docs/sprint-logs/Sfd04db/license-note.md.

manual_smoke_pending.what: Visual confirmation that pressing Ctrl+Space in the live noVNC canvas, typing 'nihongo' and converting, actually renders 日本語 into a textarea inside ungoogled-chromium — the S62374c-style real-browser Playwright-into-noVNC-canvas check.
manual_smoke_pending.why_manual: This is the one check that genuinely needs human eyes / a real interactive browser session into the rendered noVNC canvas (key events flow client → palmux WS → x11vnc RFB → Xvfb → fcitx5 → chromium). It cannot be fully driven headlessly because the IME conversion + on-canvas rendering happen below the DOM layer that CDP observes.
